method: 公开来源采集、历史去重、规则筛选与模型审阅
method_note: 系统保存当日公开元数据，与历史日报核验后排除已报道事件；论文新版本、新修订及不同软件发布等可核实更新仍可入选，随后由指定模型阅读全文摘要并完成精选。

items.title: Multimodal profiling for prediction of primary resistance to anti-PD-(L)1 therapy in advanced non-small-cell lung cancer: the prospective PIONeeR biomarkers study
items.abstract_or_text: Background Pretreatment prediction of primary resistance to anti-PD-(L)1 therapy in advanced non-small-cell lung cancer (NSCLC) remains an unmet clinical need. Existing biomarkers - including PD-L1 expression and tumour mutational burden (TMB) - are insufficiently discriminatory, and multimodal predictive models targeting primary resistance are still lacking to precisely drive patients treatment strategy. Methods PIONeeR was a prospective, multicentre biomarker study conducted across 17 centres (NCT03493581). Adults with advanced NSCLC initiating standard-of-care first-line platinum-based chemotherapy plus anti-PD-(L)1 therapy, or second-or-later-line anti-PD-(L)1 monotherapy, were enrolled. Pretreatment multimodal profiling spanned six biological layers: clinical, routine medical biology, high-dimensional circulating immune phenotyping, soluble vascular markers, tumour immune contexture with digital pathology analysis of multiplex immunohistochemistry and immunofluorescence, transcriptomics and genomics. The primary endpoint was prediction of primary resistance (PrR). Thirty-six feature-selection methods and ten machine learning models (360 pipelines) were benchmarked within a .632 optimism-correction framework. Results Between March 2018 and January 2023, 439 patients were enrolled (269 first-line, 170 subsequent-line); 435 were evaluable for PrR, which occurred in 39.5%. Individual biomarkers showed broad but modest associations with PrR (maximum AUROC 0.64). In the first-line chemo-immunotherapy setting, the multimodal signature achieved an optimism-corrected AUROC of 0.69 (s.d. 0.06) and a Positive Predictive Value (PPV) of 0.51 (s.d. 0.11) against a primary-resistance prevalence of 30%, outperforming PD-L1 (PPV 0.36, s.d. 0.02) and TMB (PPV 0.35, s.d. 0.03). In the subsequent-line setting it achieved an AUROC of 0.69 (s.d. 0.08) and a PPV of 0.64 (s.d. 0.08), where PD-L1 alone performed at least as well (PPV 0.68). The 18-feature signature included stromal regulatory T-cell infiltration, circulating transitional B cells, and multiple routine laboratory variables, with treatment-setting-dependent contributions. Interpretation Despite comprehensive multimodal pretreatment profiling, primary resistance to anti-PD-(L)1 therapy in advanced NSCLC cannot be captured by isolated biomarkers alone. Complete results are publicly accessible through an interactive dashboard (https://compo.inria.fr/pioneer-dashboard/), a reference resource for future meta-analyses. Multimodal integration improved risk stratification while highlighting the strong contribution of routinely available baseline variables. These findings support the development of clinically pragmatic models to identify patients who should access next-generation immunotherapy strategies aimed at overcoming primary resistance to PD-(L)1 inhibition.
items.summary_zh: PIONeeR 前瞻性多中心研究整合六个生物学层面的基线数据，评估晚期 NSCLC 对 anti-PD-(L)1 治疗原发耐药的预测。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 439 名患者和 360 条建模流水线提供了较强的临床验证框架；多模态模型仅取得中等 AUROC，提示不能把模型性能夸大为临床决定性证据。
items.abstract_zh: 背景：晚期非小细胞肺癌（NSCLC）接受 anti-PD-(L)1 治疗时，治疗前预测原发耐药仍是未满足的临床需求。包括 PD-L1 表达和肿瘤突变负荷（TMB）在内的现有生物标志物区分能力不足，针对原发耐药的多模态预测模型仍然缺乏，因而难以精确指导患者治疗策略。方法：PIONeeR 是一项在 17 个中心开展的前瞻性多中心生物标志物研究（NCT03493581）。研究纳入接受标准治疗的成年晚期 NSCLC 患者：一线铂类化疗联合 anti-PD-(L)1 治疗，或二线及以上 anti-PD-(L)1 单药治疗。治疗前多模态分析覆盖六个生物学层面：临床资料、常规医学检验、高维循环免疫表型、可溶性血管标志物、通过多重免疫组化和免疫荧光数字病理学分析获得的肿瘤免疫微环境、转录组学和基因组学。主要终点是预测原发耐药（PrR）。研究在 .632 乐观校正框架内，对 36 种特征选择方法和 10 种机器学习模型（360 条流水线）进行基准比较。结果：2018 年 3 月至 2023 年 1 月期间共纳入 439 名患者（269 名一线、170 名后续线）；435 名患者可评估 PrR，其中 39.5% 发生 PrR。单个生物标志物与 PrR 的关联范围较广但总体较弱（最大 AUROC 为 0.64）。在一线化疗免疫治疗场景中，多模态特征标志的乐观校正 AUROC 为 0.69（s.d. 0.06），阳性预测值（PPV）为 0.51（s.d. 0.11），而原发耐药发生率为 30%；其表现优于 PD-L1（PPV 0.36，s.d. 0.02）和 TMB（PPV 0.35，s.d. 0.03）。在后续线场景中，AUROC 为 0.69（s.d. 0.08），PPV 为 0.64（s.d. 0.08），而单独 PD-L1 的表现至少同样好（PPV 0.68）。该 18 特征标志包括基质调节性 T 细胞浸润、循环过渡性 B 细胞以及多个常规实验室变量，不同治疗场景中的贡献不同。解读：尽管进行了全面的治疗前多模态分析，晚期 NSCLC 对 anti-PD-(L)1 治疗的原发耐药仍不能由单个生物标志物单独捕获。完整结果可通过交互式仪表板公开访问（https://compo.inria.fr/pioneer-dashboard/），可作为未来荟萃分析的参考资源。多模态整合改善了风险分层，同时突出了常规可获得基线变量的较大贡献。这些结果支持开发具有临床可操作性的模型，以识别应接受旨在克服 PD-(L)1 抑制原发耐药的下一代免疫治疗策略的患者。

items.title: Glycomics Profiling Reveals a Stromal Chondroitin-4-sulfate State that Shapes Platinum Response in Ovarian Cancer
items.abstract_or_text: For women with advanced ovarian cancer (OC), remission is typically achieved through surgery and platinum-based combination chemotherapy, but the duration of response varies widely, and reliable biomarkers of platinum sensitivity remain limited. Because tumor-associated glycosaminoglycans (GAGs) influence extracellular signaling and drug interactions, but are not directly resolved by conventional transcriptomic approaches, we investigated whether direct glycomics profiling could identify a functionally relevant determinant of platinum response. Glycan reductive isotope labeling-LC/MS of ovarian cancer patient-derived xenografts (PDXs) showed that carboplatin-resistant tumors were enriched for chondroitin-4-sulfate (C4S). Single-cell transcriptomic analyses localized candidate proteoglycan scaffolds, including VCAN and BGN, primarily to stromal fibroblast compartments, supporting a stromal matrix source while underscoring that RNA measurements cannot define mature GAG abundance or fine structure. Analysis of tissue microarrays representing multiple ovarian cancer histotypes revealed high C4S expression, including in subtypes with intrinsic platinum resistance. CRISPR-mediated double XYLT1 and XYLT2 knockout reduced C4S levels, slowed ES2 tumor growth, reduced spheroid invasion, altered intraperitoneal dissemination, and eliminated ascites in the ES2 model. XYLT1/2 knockout also shifted platinum pharmacology: carboplatin uptake and DNA platination increased, whereas Triplatin accumulation and activity decreased. In PDX models, tissue rVAR2-V5 staining correlated with direct glycomics measurements and identified carboplatin-resistant tumors selectively sensitive to the GAG-targeting platinum agent Triplatin. These findings nominate a stromal-associated C4S-rich extracellular state as a non-genetic determinant of platinum response and tumor behavior, and support tissue-level C4S assessment for biomarker-guided evaluation of Triplatin.
items.summary_zh: 糖组学、单细胞转录组和 PDX 实验证实，基质软骨素-4-硫酸（C4S）状态与卵巢癌铂类反应相关。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究把成熟糖胺聚糖的直接测量与基因编辑、药理学和 PDX 验证结合起来，为铂类耐药的基质相关机制和 Triplatin 分层提供了实验线索。
items.abstract_zh: 对于晚期卵巢癌（OC）女性，手术和铂类联合化疗通常可以实现缓解，但反应持续时间差异很大，可靠的铂类敏感性生物标志物仍然有限。由于肿瘤相关糖胺聚糖（GAG）会影响细胞外信号和药物相互作用，而常规转录组学不能直接解析它们，我们研究了直接糖组学分析是否能够识别与铂类反应具有功能相关性的决定因素。对卵巢癌患者来源异种移植模型（PDX）进行糖还原性同位素标记-LC/MS 分析显示，卡铂耐药肿瘤富集软骨素-4-硫酸（C4S）。单细胞转录组分析将包括 VCAN 和 BGN 在内的候选蛋白聚糖支架主要定位于基质成纤维细胞区室，支持其基质来源，同时也表明 RNA 测量不能确定成熟 GAG 的丰度或精细结构。对代表多种卵巢癌组织学类型的组织微阵列进行分析发现，C4S 高表达，包括在具有内在铂类耐药性的亚型中。CRISPR 介导的 XYLT1 和 XYLT2 双敲除降低了 C4S 水平，减缓 ES2 肿瘤生长，减少球体侵袭，改变腹腔播散，并在 ES2 模型中消除腹水。XYLT1/2 敲除还改变了铂类药物的药理学：卡铂摄取和 DNA 铂化增加，而 Triplatin 的积累和活性降低。在 PDX 模型中，组织 rVAR2-V5 染色与直接糖组学测量相关，并识别出对 GAG 靶向铂类药物 Triplatin 选择性敏感的卡铂耐药肿瘤。这些发现提出了一种富含基质相关 C4S 的细胞外状态，作为铂类反应和肿瘤行为的非遗传决定因素，并支持在组织层面评估 C4S，以指导 Triplatin 的生物标志物分层评价。
items.author_line: Peterson, E. J., Hampton, J. D., Clausen, T. M., Beaudin, A. R., Deshmukh, S. P., Dozmorov, M. G., Turner, J. B. M., Basu, A., Vidal-Calvo, E. E., Leonard, C. E., Hwang, P. Y., Daugaard, M., Salanti, A., Weiss, R. J., Koblinski, J. E., Litovchick, L., Farrell, N. P.

items.title: Panoramic modelling of single-cell transcriptomes at scale with CellNet
items.abstract_or_text: Comprehensively characterizing cellular diversity is critical for understanding tissue development, identifying disease-associated populations and investigating gene programmes linked to specialized functions. Advances in single-cell profiling reveal additional cell-specific transcripts and molecular associations, yet many foundation models represent only a restricted portion of this increasingly rich molecular information. Here we present CellNet, which enables panoramic modelling of single-cell transcriptomes by integrating DNA-derived gene identities and measured RNA expression in a shared image representation. Pretrained on 231 million cell profiles spanning 40 species, CellNet improves rare-population and condition-associated state recognition in evaluated cohorts while retaining competitive general cell representations. It predicts withheld coding-gene expression and selected non-coding targets in total-RNA data, and recovers lineage-specific expression patterns in spatial measurements. Prediction also extends across species, including to targets without expression-pretraining exposure. Its gene representations retrieve known non-coding modules and developmental or neural programmes, including from sparsely detected RNA queries. Together, these results establish CellNet as a scalable framework for interpreting cellular diversity through increasingly comprehensive transcriptomic measurements.
items.summary_zh: CellNet 将 DNA 来源的基因身份与 RNA 表达编码到共享图像表示中，并在 40 个物种的 2.31 亿细胞谱系上预训练。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 超大规模预训练、跨物种迁移和空间转录组泛化使其适合稀有细胞状态与非编码模块分析，但摘要未提供具体外部实验验证。
items.abstract_zh: 全面刻画细胞多样性对于理解组织发育、识别疾病相关细胞群以及研究与特化功能相关的基因程序至关重要。单细胞分析技术的进展揭示了更多细胞特异性转录本和分子关联，但许多基础模型只表示了这一日益丰富的分子信息中的有限部分。我们提出 CellNet，通过在共享图像表示中整合 DNA 衍生的基因身份和实测 RNA 表达，实现对单细胞转录组的全景建模。CellNet 在覆盖 40 个物种的 2.31 亿个细胞谱系上进行预训练，在评估队列中改善了稀有细胞群和条件相关状态的识别，同时保持具有竞争力的通用细胞表示能力。它能够预测总 RNA 数据中被留出的蛋白编码基因表达和选定的非编码靶标，并在空间测量中恢复谱系特异性表达模式。该预测能力还可跨物种扩展，包括扩展到预训练时未接触过表达数据的靶标。其基因表示能够从稀疏检测的 RNA 查询中检索已知的非编码模块以及发育或神经基因程序。总体而言，这些结果建立了一个可扩展框架，用于通过日益全面的转录组测量来解释细胞多样性。
items.author_line: Xiaoqing Lian, Pei Liu, Jiahui Tan, Luoda Tan, Chaoyi Li, Quan Zou, Chen Lin, Xiangxiang Zeng

items.title: A Proteome-Wide, Accelerated Deep Learning Framework for Structural Interactome Docking, Polygenic Disease Network Translation and Automated Druggability Assessment
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Characterizing the protein-protein interactions (PPI’s) enable novel therapeutic strategies and defining precise disease mechanisms for human diseases including cardiovascular space. However, vast gap remains between theoretical PPI’s search space and physically validated data due to the high cost, low throughput, and high false-positive rates. We present an AI-driven, high-performance computing framework to map the human structural interactome and identify novel therapeutic PPIs for cardiovascular diseases. To overcome historical structure-availability and throughput bottlenecks, we combined proteome-wide AI-predicted structures (Published by Innophore) with NVIDIA’s EquiDock, an end-to-end deep learning docking framework. Deployed across 460 NVIDIA’s H100 GPUs, this interaction-aware pipeline evaluated a curated matrix of 3.3 million co-localized protein pairs, successfully reducing rigid docking runtimes from hours to seconds. We calculated binding free energies using PRODIGY and integrated these deep learning-derived PPIs with population-scale GWAS datasets, like CARDIoGRAM and Pan-UK Biobank, to map cardiovascular polygenic networks. The draggability assessment for these novel targets was done using a PocketVec-driven chemogenomic classifier and rDock screening. Cross-referencing our predictions against benchmark interactome repositories (HuRI, BioGRID, STRING, PDBbind) isolated hundreds of thousands of high-confidence, novel physical interactions. Retrospective literature benchmarking confirmed that this computational framework prospectively anticipated subsequent wet-lab discoveries, including TCAP–COLQ and SDHA–IDH2.
items.summary_zh: 该框架在 460 张 NVIDIA H100 GPU 上对 330 万个共定位蛋白对进行结构互作对接，并与 GWAS、可成药性模型和文献基准结合。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 计算规模和多源整合突出，但高置信新互作主要来自计算预测；摘要中的湿实验支持是回溯性文献印证，不能等同于系统实验验证。
items.abstract_zh: 表征蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）能够支持新的治疗策略，并阐明包括心血管疾病在内的人类疾病的精确机制。然而，理论 PPI 搜索空间与物理验证数据之间仍存在巨大差距，原因包括成本高、通量低和假阳性率高。我们提出了一个由人工智能驱动的高性能计算框架，用于绘制人类结构互作组并识别心血管疾病的新型治疗性 PPI。为克服结构可获得性和通量方面的历史瓶颈，我们将全蛋白质组范围的 AI 预测结构（由 Innophore 发布）与 NVIDIA 的 EquiDock（一种端到端深度学习对接框架）结合起来。该具有相互作用感知能力的流水线部署在 460 张 NVIDIA H100 GPU 上，对一个经过整理的 330 万个共定位蛋白对矩阵进行评估，并成功将刚性对接运行时间从数小时缩短到数秒。我们使用 PRODIGY 计算结合自由能，并将这些深度学习得到的 PPI 与 CARDIoGRAM 和 Pan-UK Biobank 等群体规模 GWAS 数据集整合，以绘制心血管多基因网络。针对这些新靶点的可成药性评估采用 PocketVec 驱动的化学基因组分类器和 rDock 筛选完成。通过将预测结果与 HuRI、BioGRID、STRING 和 PDBbind 等基准互作组数据库交叉比对，我们筛选出数十万条高置信的新型物理相互作用。回溯性文献基准分析证实，该计算框架前瞻性地预测到了随后出现的湿实验发现，包括 TCAP–COLQ 和 SDHA–IDH2。
items.author_line: Bhandare V, Khatal S, Scheele J, Agarwal A, Sarode K, Chatterjee S, Kondhalkar U, Joshi P, Ahluwalia A, Yadav R

items.title: EZPro-Fit: A Thermophile-Informed Cross-Modal Generative Framework Integrating DNA Language and Protein Structure for Enzyme Mutant Design
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Generative models are transforming enzyme engineering by exploring vast protein sequence spaces while reducing experimental screening. However, most approaches optimize proteins without considering their genetic encoding and host expression. Here, we introduce EZPro-Fit, a multimodal generative framework that jointly learns protein structures, coding sequences (CDSs), and taxonomic information from thermophilic microorganisms, coupling structural design with nucleotide-level implementation. Pretraining on thermophilic proteins followed by Escherichia coli-conditioned fine-tuning captures signals related to protein conformation, thermal resilience, codon usage, and host compatibility. EZPro-Fit enables bidirectional inference between structures and CDSs and generates host-adapted coding sequences while preserving protein-level constraints. Cross-species benchmarks demonstrate improved codon adaptation and learning of structure-associated coding principles of thermostable proteins. For Cel5E engineering, EZPro-Fit identified novel variants, including D259E and N291D, that experimentally improved both melting temperature and catalytic activity. EZPro-Fit thus provides a genetically executable framework for host-aware enzyme design and industrial biocatalysis.
items.summary_zh: EZPro-Fit 联合学习热嗜性微生物的蛋白质结构、编码序列和分类信息，并针对 Escherichia coli 进行宿主条件微调。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 模型把结构设计与可执行的核苷酸编码连接起来，并在 Cel5E 中以 D259E 和 N291D 实验改进熔解温度和催化活性。
items.abstract_zh: 生成模型正在改变酶工程：它们能够探索巨大的蛋白质序列空间，同时减少实验筛选量。然而，大多数方法在优化蛋白质时没有考虑其遗传编码和宿主表达。我们提出 EZPro-Fit，这是一种多模态生成框架，联合学习来自嗜热微生物的蛋白质结构、编码序列（CDS）和分类学信息，将结构设计与核苷酸层面的实现结合起来。在嗜热蛋白上进行预训练后，再以 Escherichia coli 为条件进行微调，从而捕获与蛋白质构象、耐热性、密码子使用和宿主相容性相关的信号。EZPro-Fit 支持结构与 CDS 之间的双向推断，并在保持蛋白质层面约束的同时生成适应宿主的编码序列。跨物种基准测试显示，该模型改善了密码子适应，并学习到稳定蛋白质中与结构相关的编码原则。在 Cel5E 工程中，EZPro-Fit 识别出包括 D259E 和 N291D 在内的新变体；实验表明，这些变体同时提高了熔解温度和催化活性。因此，EZPro-Fit 为宿主感知的酶设计和工业生物催化提供了一个具有遗传可执行性的框架。
items.author_line: Xu R, Zhao L, Pei R, Xu Y, Zhou Z, Duan H, Wei L, Zheng L, Liu D, Guo J

items.title: Tissue Reconstruction with Generative AI
items.abstract_or_text: The spatial arrangement of cells is fundamental to their function, but single-cell RNA sequencing dissociates cells from their native spatial context. We present LUNA, a generative AI model that reconstructs tissue architecture from dissociated gene expression profiles by learning spatial priors from spatially resolved transcriptomics datasets. We validate LUNA by reconstructing the MERFISH mouse brain atlas comprising over 1.2 million cells, inferring the spatial locations of dissociated cells in a mouse central nervous system single-cell RNA-sequencing atlas, and enriching the Slide-tags data by imputing the locations of nuclei lost during profiling. LUNA generalizes to previously unseen cell types in the MERFISH mouse brain atlas and to pathological samples, identifying regions of disease-associated alterations in a mouse model of Parkinson's disease. Our results establish generative tissue reconstruction as an approach for overcoming current technological limitations in spatial biology and advancing our understanding of tissue organization and function.
items.summary_zh: LUNA 从解离的基因表达谱重建组织空间结构，并在超过 120 万个细胞的 MERFISH 小鼠脑图谱及帕金森病模型中进行验证。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它为单细胞测序丢失空间信息提供生成式补偿，并展示了对未见细胞类型和病理样本的泛化。
items.abstract_zh: 细胞的空间排列是其功能的基础，但单细胞 RNA 测序会将细胞从原生空间环境中解离出来。我们提出 LUNA，这是一种生成式 AI 模型，通过从空间分辨转录组数据集中学习空间先验，根据解离的基因表达谱重建组织结构。我们通过重建包含超过 120 万个细胞的 MERFISH 小鼠脑图谱、推断小鼠中枢神经系统单细胞 RNA 测序图谱中解离细胞的空间位置，以及通过插补分析过程中丢失的细胞核位置来丰富 Slide-tags 数据，对 LUNA 进行了验证。LUNA 能够泛化到 MERFISH 小鼠脑图谱中此前未见的细胞类型以及病理样本，并在帕金森病小鼠模型中识别出疾病相关改变区域。我们的结果表明，生成式组织重建可以克服空间生物学当前的技术限制，并推进对组织组织结构和功能的理解。
items.author_line: Yu, T., Ekbote, C., Morozov, N., Herrera, A., Fan, J., Dominguez Mantes, A., Novello, S., Lashuel, H., Frossard, P., d'Ascoli, S., La Manno, G., Brbic, M.

items.title: Can GPT Be Used as an Alternative Prediction Model to Traditional Machine Learning and Neural Networks on Low-Volume Clinical Data?
items.abstract_or_text: Background and Objective: Early and reliable disease prediction from structured clinical data remains challenging when datasets are small, highly imbalanced, and contain limited positive disease cases. Conventional machine learning (ML) and deep learning approaches often struggle to capture clinically meaningful relationships under such low-data representation conditions due to weak statistical associations between features and prediction targets. This study proposes a clinically grounded GPT2-based table-to-text framework for disease prediction using structured healthcare datasets, motivated by the contextual reasoning capability of GPT models to better capture clinically meaningful relationships when statistical learning alone becomes insufficient due to limited data availability. Methods & Materials: Structured clinical records were transformed into physician-style textual descriptions and enriched through GPT4-generated medical paraphrasing to improve minority-class representation while preserving clinical meaning. Both the original and generated clinical texts were used to fine-tune a GPT2 model across four public healthcare datasets, including heart disease, heart failure, chronic kidney disease, and thyroid cancer recurrence. Gradient-based explainable AI analysis was additionally incorporated to identify clinically important features influencing prediction outcomes. Results: The proposed framework demonstrated consistently strong predictive performance with average precision, specificity, sensitivity, and F1-score of 0.96, 0.97, 0.96, and 0.96, respectively. The model achieved improved sensitivity, stronger generalization, and more stable predictive behavior compared with traditional ML, deep learning, transformer-based, and GAN-augmented approaches. Importantly, the framework consistently emphasized clinically meaningful variables even under severe class imbalance where conventional ML and neural network models often struggled. Conclusions: The proposed GPT2-based table-to-text framework provides a practical and clinically interpretable approach for disease prediction from limited structured healthcare data. By integrating contextual clinical reasoning with explainable prediction mechanisms, the framework demonstrates strong potential for early risk detection, transparent clinical decision support, and reliable deployment in real-world low-resource healthcare environments.
items.summary_zh: 研究把结构化临床记录转写为医生风格文本，用 GPT4 生成医学释义增强少数类，再微调 GPT2 进行四类低样本疾病预测。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 四个公开数据集上的平均 precision、specificity、sensitivity 和 F1-score 均较高，但这是预印本模型研究，不能视为真实临床部署证据。
items.abstract_zh: 背景与目的：从结构化临床数据中早期、可靠地预测疾病仍然具有挑战性，尤其是在数据集规模小、高度不平衡且疾病阳性病例有限的情况下。当数据表示量较低时，传统机器学习（ML）和深度学习方法往往难以捕捉具有临床意义的关系，因为特征与预测目标之间的统计关联较弱。本研究提出一种以临床为基础的 GPT2 表格到文本框架，用于基于结构化医疗数据的疾病预测；其出发点是，在数据可用性有限、单纯统计学习不足时，GPT 模型的上下文推理能力可能更好地捕捉具有临床意义的关系。方法与材料：将结构化临床记录转换为医生风格的文本描述，并通过 GPT4 生成的医学释义进行增强，以改善少数类表示，同时保持临床含义。使用原始临床文本和生成的临床文本，在四个公开医疗数据集上对 GPT2 进行微调，包括心脏病、心力衰竭、慢性肾病和甲状腺癌复发。研究还加入基于梯度的可解释 AI 分析，以识别影响预测结果的临床重要特征。结果：所提出框架表现出持续较强的预测性能，平均 precision、specificity、sensitivity 和 F1-score 分别为 0.96、0.97、0.96 和 0.96。与传统 ML、深度学习、基于 Transformer 的模型和 GAN 增强方法相比，该模型取得了更高的 sensitivity、更强的泛化能力和更稳定的预测行为。值得注意的是，即使在严重类别不平衡的情况下，该框架仍持续强调具有临床意义的变量，而传统 ML 和神经网络模型在这种情况下往往表现不佳。结论：所提出的基于 GPT2 的表格到文本框架为从有限结构化临床数据进行疾病预测提供了一种实用且具有临床可解释性的方法。通过将上下文临床推理与可解释预测机制结合，该框架显示出用于早期风险检测、透明临床决策支持以及在现实低资源医疗环境中可靠部署的潜力。
items.author_line: Bin Akter, S., Akter, S., Eisenberg, D., Hill, C., Lotvola, A., Fresneda Fernandez, J., Sarkar Pias, T., Rafiqul Islam, M., Islam, H.

items.title: Multimodal Artificial Intelligence for Cause-of-Death Assignment From Verbal Autopsy Records: A National Benchmark Study in South Africa
items.abstract_or_text: BACKGROUND Timely cause-of-death (COD) information guides health policy, yet many deaths in low- and middle-income countries are not medically certified. In Africa, fewer than 10% of deaths are. Verbal autopsy (VA) yields a structured symptom questionnaire and a free-text narrative. Mortality surveillance increasingly records the narrative alongside the questionnaire, but the algorithms used to produce VA-based statistics were designed for structured responses only, so narratives inform physician COD assignment but do not contribute to algorithmic COD assignment. We evaluated whether supervised models could use both modalities to improve COD assignment. METHODS We analyzed 4,999 VA records for deaths at ages 12 years or older from a national sample of registered deaths in South Africa (RSA), using physician-assigned CODs as the reference standard. We trained unimodal and multimodal pipelines on the labelled records: pretrained language models (PLMs) fine-tuned on narratives alone, machine learning (ML) models on structured responses alone, and the two combined at the data, feature, and decision levels. We also prompted a locally deployed generative large language model (LLM) on the same unimodal and multimodal inputs, without parameter updates. All were compared with InSilicoVA, the operational comparator representing current automated practice. We evaluated individual-level assignment, population-level agreement, calibration, and generalization across provinces in RSA, reporting these metrics rather than ranking pipelines on any one of them. RESULTS Every supervised pipeline improved on InSilicoVA by 8.5-15.9 percentage points in top-1 accuracy and 3.5-7.1 points in cause-specific mortality fraction (CSMF) accuracy. The narrative and structured pipelines performed similarly in aggregate but differed by cause: 63.9% of deaths received identical predictions, 11.6% were correct only from the narrative pipeline, and 13.6% only from the questionnaire pipeline, with the narrative pipeline more accurate for noncommunicable causes and the questionnaire pipeline for communicable causes. Against the unimodal approaches, the decision-fusion pipelines added 4.2-5.4 percentage points in top-1 accuracy, concentrated in the most common causes, whereas feature fusion with cross-modal attention improved the less common causes, adding 6.6 points (95% CI, 1.7-11.5) in balanced accuracy and 5.5 points (95% CI, 0.6-10.3) in macro F1. Feature fusion reached the highest CSMF accuracy (95.7%). Paired differences from the better unimodal representative ranged from -0.2 to +3.4 points, with all intervals including zero. The LLM exceeded InSilicoVA on individual-level metrics and reached the highest balanced accuracy of any pipeline (60.6%), while the supervised pipelines retained higher CSMF accuracy. Supervised pipelines had lower expected calibration error than InSilicoVA. Supervised gains held across all nine held-out provinces, including every top-1 comparison and nearly every macro F1 and CSMF comparison. CONCLUSIONS PLMs using narratives alone substantially improved on current best practice and matched ML pipelines using structured responses, while multiple multimodal strategies produced further gains in individual COD assignment. The zero-shot LLM showed particular strength on rare causes, whereas supervised pipelines better recovered the population cause distribution. These findings support incorporating narratives as a core input to automated VA systems and evaluating representative fusion strategies for the intended output. External validation across settings and age groups will support broader implementation.
items.summary_zh: 南非全国样本的 4,999 条 verbal autopsy 记录显示，融合叙述文本与结构化症状可改善死因分配，并在九个留出省份保持增益。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究同时评估个体级准确率、群体死因构成、校准和跨省泛化，且明确指出外部验证仍需扩展到其他地区和年龄组。
items.abstract_zh: 背景：及时的死因（COD）信息能够指导卫生政策，但低收入和中等收入国家的许多死亡没有经过医学认证。在非洲，经过医学认证的死亡不到 10%。口头尸检（VA）同时产生结构化症状问卷和自由文本叙述。死亡监测越来越多地记录叙述文本和问卷，但用于生成基于 VA 统计数据的算法原本只针对结构化回答设计，因此叙述文本可以帮助医生分配死因，却没有参与算法式死因分配。我们评估了监督式模型能否利用两种模态来改善死因分配。方法：我们分析了南非（RSA）登记死亡全国样本中年龄 12 岁及以上死亡者的 4,999 条 VA 记录，并以医生分配的死因为参考标准。我们在带标签记录上训练单模态和多模态流水线：单独在叙述文本上微调的预训练语言模型（PLM）、单独处理结构化回答的机器学习（ML）模型，以及在数据、特征和决策层面进行两者融合的模型。我们还在相同的单模态和多模态输入上提示一个本地部署的生成式大型语言模型（LLM），不更新其参数。所有模型均与 InSilicoVA（代表当前自动化实践的实际比较器）进行比较。我们评估个体级分配、群体级一致性、校准和跨南非各省的泛化能力，并报告这些指标，而不是只用其中一个指标对流水线排名。结果：所有监督式流水线相较 InSilicoVA 的 top-1 准确率提高了 8.5–15.9 个百分点，死因构成（CSMF）准确率提高了 3.5–7.1 个百分点。叙述文本流水线和结构化流水线的总体表现相近，但按死因不同：63.9% 的死亡病例得到完全相同的预测，11.6% 只有叙述文本流水线预测正确，13.6% 只有问卷流水线预测正确；叙述文本流水线对非传染性死因更准确，而问卷流水线对传染性死因更准确。相较单模态方法，决策融合流水线的 top-1 准确率增加了 4.2–5.4 个百分点，增益集中在最常见死因；带跨模态注意力的特征融合改善了较少见死因，平衡准确率增加 6.6 个百分点（95% CI，1.7–11.5），宏 F1 增加 5.5 个百分点（95% CI，0.6–10.3）。特征融合取得最高的 CSMF 准确率（95.7%）。相对于表现更好的单模态代表方法，配对差异为 -0.2 至 +3.4 个百分点，所有区间均包含零。LLM 在个体级指标上超过 InSilicoVA，并达到所有流水线中最高的平衡准确率（60.6%），而监督式流水线保持更高的 CSMF 准确率。监督式流水线的预期校准误差低于 InSilicoVA。监督式增益在全部九个留出省份中均保持，包括每个 top-1 比较以及几乎所有宏 F1 和 CSMF 比较。结论：仅使用叙述文本的 PLM 相较当前最佳实践有显著改善，并与使用结构化回答的 ML 流水线表现相当；多种多模态策略进一步提高了个体死因分配。零样本 LLM 在罕见死因上表现尤其突出，而监督式流水线更好地恢复了群体死因分布。这些结果支持将叙述文本作为自动化 VA 系统的核心输入，并针对预期输出评估具有代表性的融合策略。在更广泛实施之前，还需要在不同环境和年龄组中进行外部验证。
items.author_line: Chu, Y., Wu, Z., McCormick, T. H., Li, Z. R., Clark, S. J.

items.title: ZebraSeek integrates complementary facial and clinical evidence for rare disease prioritization
items.abstract_or_text: Rare diseases can remain undiagnosed for years because individual disorders are uncom-mon and clinically heterogeneous, while relevant clues are distributed across structuredphenotypes, facial appearance, prior cases and disease knowledge. Computational toolscan use Human Phenotype Ontology (HPO)-encoded findings, genomic data and increas-ingly diverse medical images, but these modalities are processed by models with differentoutputs and score scales. ZebraSeek converts clinical and facial inputs into ranked diseasecandidates with specialist tools, then uses a large language model (LLM) to integrateand externally check those candidates while retaining their sources. Facial-image analysisprovides a complementary machine-readable phenotype that can capture patterns notfully represented by manually encoded HPO terms. In 74 literature-derived cases spanning19 diseases, ZebraSeek placed the recorded diagnosis first in 50 (67.6%) and within fivein 59 (79.7%); it recovered 11 diagnoses outside PubCaseFinder’s top five, while fivediagnoses present in PubCaseFinder’s top five were absent from ZebraSeek’s final top five.During DBCLS BioHackathon 2026, we expanded analysis to 368 patients, 462 imagesand 54 disorders to examine how candidate depth affects coverage and downstreamcandidate count, and to assess the feasibility of case-specific candidate selection.
items.summary_zh: ZebraSeek 将面部图像、HPO 表型、基因组数据和文献知识结合，用于罕见病候选诊断排序。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 74 个文献病例中 67.6% 的记录诊断排名第一，另有 368 名患者的扩展分析；结果支持候选排序工具的辅助价值，尚不足以替代临床诊断。
items.abstract_zh: 罕见病可能多年无法确诊，因为单个疾病并不常见且临床异质性高，而相关线索分散在结构化表型、面部外观、既往病例和疾病知识中。计算工具可以使用人类表型本体（HPO）编码的发现、基因组数据以及日益多样的医学图像，但这些模态由具有不同输出和评分尺度的模型处理。ZebraSeek 使用专门工具将临床和面部输入转换为疾病候选排序，然后利用大型语言模型（LLM）整合这些候选并进行外部检查，同时保留其来源。面部图像分析提供了一种互补的机器可读表型，可以捕捉未被人工编码 HPO 术语充分表示的模式。在涵盖 19 种疾病的 74 个文献病例中，ZebraSeek 将记录中的诊断排在第一位的病例有 50 个（67.6%），排在前五位以内的有 59 个（79.7%）；它找回了 11 个不在 PubCaseFinder 前五位中的诊断，而 PubCaseFinder 前五位中有 5 个诊断未出现在 ZebraSeek 的最终前五位中。在 2026 年 DBCLS BioHackathon 期间，我们将分析扩展到 368 名患者、462 张图像和 54 种疾病，以研究候选深度如何影响覆盖率和后续候选数量，并评估按病例选择候选的可行性。
items.author_line: Yoshikuwa N, Chiba H, Okazaki T, Shin J, Dohi E, Mishima H, Yamaguchi A, Hsieh T, Buske O, Goto S, Fujiwara T

items.title: Tool-Augmented Large Language Models for Reliable Medical Calculation from Patient Notes
items.abstract_or_text: Medical calculators translate raw patient observations into clinically actionable values and scores. However, applying these calculators directly to free-form patient notes requires precise variable extraction combined with the exact execution of complex formulas, scoring rules, and output conventions. Relying solely on direct large language model (LLM) prompting is unreliable in this context, as rule recall, parameter extraction, arithmetic reasoning, and formatting become entangled within a single generative step. To address these limitations, we propose a tool-augmented LLM framework for reliable medical calculation from patient notes. The framework retrieves and structures calculator specifications, generates reusable executable tools, and uses a constrained extractor to map each patient note to calculator-ready inputs. The tools then perform deterministic calculation, separating clinical language understanding from rule execution and arithmetic. Evaluated on the MedCalc-Bench dataset, our method achieves 86.73% final-answer accuracy, outperforming the one-shot prompting and supervised fine tuning-only baselines by 24.0 and 17.27 percentage points. Ablation and error analyses show that these performance gains are primarily driven by rule-grounded tool synthesis and schema-constrained extraction, whereas remaining failures are concentrated in clinical-semantic extraction and benchmark-specific output contracts. By grounding calculator logic in executable tools, the proposed approach alleviates arithmetic hallucinations and improves the computational reliability of the final clinical outputs.
items.summary_zh: 工具增强 LLM 将临床计算器规范检索、受约束变量抽取和确定性计算分离，在 MedCalc-Bench 上达到 86.73% 最终答案准确率。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 方法把语言理解与公式执行解耦，并通过消融分析定位收益来源；仍需在真实临床流程中验证。
items.abstract_zh: 医学计算器将原始患者观察结果转换为具有临床可操作性的数值和评分。然而，直接将这些计算器应用于自由文本患者记录，需要同时精确抽取变量，并准确执行复杂公式、评分规则和输出规范。仅依赖直接的大型语言模型（LLM）提示在此场景下并不可靠，因为规则记忆、参数抽取、算术推理和格式化被纠缠在单个生成步骤中。为解决这些问题，我们提出一种工具增强 LLM 框架，用于从患者记录中可靠地进行医学计算。该框架检索并结构化计算器规范，生成可重复使用的可执行工具，并使用受约束的抽取器将每份患者记录映射为可供计算器使用的输入。随后由工具执行确定性计算，将临床语言理解与规则执行和算术运算分开。在 MedCalc-Bench 数据集上的评估中，该方法最终答案准确率达到 86.73%，比一次性提示和仅监督微调基线分别高 24.0 个百分点和 17.27 个百分点。消融和错误分析显示，性能提升主要由基于规则的工具合成和模式约束抽取驱动；剩余错误集中在临床语义抽取和基准特定的输出契约上。通过将计算器逻辑落实为可执行工具，该方法减轻了算术幻觉，并提高了最终临床输出的计算可靠性。
items.author_line: Yang Zhong, Ling Luo, Xuanlyu Zhu, Yanhua Wang, Yuanyuan Sun, Jian Wang, Hongfei Lin

items.title: Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning in Stem Cell Bioprocessing: From Monitoring to Autonomous Manufacturing
items.abstract_or_text: Background: Stem cell bioprocessing requires timely assessment of cell state and control over variable expansion and differentiation. Automated culture can execute predefined steps, whereas adaptive manufacturing uses observations to guide decisions during an ongoing batch. Objective: This review examines how artificial intelligence and machine learning connect process monitoring to prediction and feedback control, and assesses which links have been demonstrated in stem cell systems.Key Content: This topic covers image-based phenotyping, physical and multimodal sensing, growth and differentiation forecasts, process optimization, hybrid models, and proposed digital twins. A descriptive Level 0–6 continuum distinguishes endpoint assessment, monitoring, state estimation, prediction, operator decision support, within-run feedback, and coordinated workflow autonomy. Reported studies demonstrate image-guided adjustments to differentiation, robotic optimization across experiments, and rule-based feedback within a culture. However, these capabilities do not demonstrate autonomous production of a clinically releasable cell product. Translation is further limited by reduced model performance when entire experiments are withheld from training, fragmented datasets, variation across donors and processes, uncertain links between surrogate measures and potency, and the need for model governance. Conclusion: Supervised adaptation and supervised autonomy are credible near-term targets, characterized by bounded, traceable interventions with human oversight and a defined response to uncertainty. Prospective studies should compare adaptive and fixed processes across independent batches and assess cell identity, relevant function, safety-related attributes, and resource use. Claims of full autonomy require verified performance across the manufacturing workflow.
items.summary_zh: 综述以 Level 0–6 连续谱梳理干细胞 AI 制造，从成像表型和传感监测延伸到反馈控制与数字孪生。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 文章明确区分了辅助决策、受监督适应和真正自主生产，指出跨批次、供体差异、效力关联和治理仍是临床转化瓶颈。
items.abstract_zh: 背景：干细胞生物加工需要及时评估细胞状态，并控制扩增和分化过程中的变异。自动化培养可以执行预先定义的步骤，而自适应制造则利用正在进行的批次中的观测结果来指导决策。目的：本综述考察人工智能和机器学习如何将过程监测连接到预测和反馈控制，并评估这些连接中的哪些已经在干细胞系统中得到证明。主要内容：主题涵盖基于图像的表型分析、物理和多模态传感、生长和分化预测、过程优化、混合模型以及提出的数字孪生。描述性的 Level 0–6 连续谱区分了终点评估、监测、状态估计、预测、操作员决策支持、批次内反馈和协调工作流自主性。已有研究展示了图像引导的分化调整、跨实验的机器人优化以及培养过程中的基于规则的反馈。然而，这些能力并不能证明能够自主生产临床上可放行的细胞产品。当整个实验被留作测试时，模型性能下降、数据集碎片化、供体和工艺差异、替代测量与效力之间的关联不确定，以及对模型治理的需求，进一步限制了转化。结论：受监督的适应和受监督的自主性是可信的近期目标，其特征是有界且可追踪的干预、人工监督以及对不确定性的明确定义响应。前瞻性研究应在独立批次上比较自适应流程和固定流程，并评估细胞身份、相关功能、安全性相关属性和资源使用。关于完全自主的主张需要在整个制造工作流中验证性能。

items.title: Quantitative Facial Phenotyping and Age-Associated Differences in Sickle Cell Disease Using Interpretable Machine Learning
items.abstract_or_text: Background Sickle cell disease (SCD) is a common inherited genetic disorder and contributor to global childhood mortality and morbidity, particularly in Sub-Saharan Africa. Craniofacial and skeletal changes have been described in SCD, but the subtle soft-tissue facial patterns and their variation have not been quantitatively characterized using machine-learning methods. Methods: We analyzed 308 front-facing smartphone photographs from 154 participants with electrophoresis-confirmed SCD and 154 age- and sex-matched controls aged from 5 months to 19 years recruited in Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo. Predefined geometric and texture-based facial descriptors were extracted from standardized images using manually annotated landmarks. An interpretable linear support vector machine with recursive feature elimination was evaluated using leave-one-out cross-validation, with features ranked according to their relevance for distinguishing participants with SCD from controls. Cross-sectional age- and sex- stratified analyses evaluated variation in selected features Results: The facial analysis algorithm identified eight geometric and six texture discriminative features that were significantly different between the cohorts. A combination of six geometric features contributed most consistently to internal discrimination: distance between medial and lateral canthi, angle at nasal ala, distance from nasion to philtrum, distance from medial canthi to the columella, distance from columella to the lower lip, and distance between nasal alae. The model achieved an AUROC of 0.843 [95% CI: 0.798,0.887], and an accuracy of 0.795 [95% CI: 0.750,0.840]. Between-group difference was limited in the youngest age groups and were more pronounced in several older age groups. Conclusion: These findings demonstrate preliminary evidence that SCD is associated with quantifiable morphometric patterns. External, longitudinal, and clinically characterized studies are needed to determine whether these features may serve as reproducible digital biomarkers within a broader supportive disease-assessment framework.
items.summary_zh: 研究用 154 名镰状细胞病患者和 154 名匹配对照的 308 张智能手机正面照片，建立可解释面部表型模型。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 内部 AUROC 为 0.843，但作者明确需要外部、纵向和临床表征研究，当前只能视为初步数字生物标志物证据。
items.abstract_zh: 背景：镰状细胞病（SCD）是一种常见的遗传性疾病，也是全球儿童死亡和患病负担的原因之一，在撒哈拉以南非洲尤其如此。SCD 患者的颅面和骨骼变化已有描述，但细微的软组织面部模式及其变化尚未使用机器学习方法进行定量表征。方法：我们分析了来自刚果民主共和国金沙萨的 154 名电泳确诊 SCD 参与者和 154 名按年龄、性别匹配的对照者的 308 张正面智能手机照片；参与者年龄为 5 个月至 19 岁。研究者从标准化图像中使用人工标注的地标点提取预先定义的几何和纹理面部描述符。采用带递归特征消除的可解释线性支持向量机，并使用留一法交叉验证进行评估；特征按照其区分 SCD 参与者与对照者的相关性排序。横断面、按年龄和性别分层的分析评估了所选特征的变化。结果：面部分析算法识别出 8 个几何判别特征和 6 个纹理判别特征，这些特征在两组之间存在显著差异。6 个几何特征的组合对内部区分贡献最稳定：内眦与外眦之间的距离、鼻翼角、鼻根点到人中的距离、内眦到鼻小柱的距离、鼻小柱到下唇的距离，以及两侧鼻翼之间的距离。模型 AUROC 为 0.843［95% CI：0.798，0.887］，准确率为 0.795［95% CI：0.750，0.840］。最年轻年龄组的组间差异有限，而在若干年龄较大的组中差异更加明显。结论：这些发现提供了初步证据，表明 SCD 与可量化的形态测量模式相关。需要外部、纵向且具有临床表征的研究，才能确定这些特征是否能在更广泛的辅助疾病评估框架中作为可重复的数字生物标志物。

items.title: Auditing Escalation Reliability in Healthcare LLM Agents: A Perturbation-Controlled Benchmark of Workflow-State Failures
items.abstract_or_text: Trustworthy biomedical AI requires reliable action selection when evidence is missing, stale, conflicting, or late, not only accurate answers on static inputs. We instantiate an episode-level evaluation protocol as 400 synthetic healthcare workflow episodes: 40 hand-authored semantic seeds across four task classes, two surface parameterizations, and five controlled variants, scored on ANSWER/ASK CLARIFICATION/ABSTAIN/ESCALATE under a pre-declared 5:1 missed-versus-unnecessary escalation cost. Reference actions are single-author study-policy labels, not clinician-adjudicated ground truth. Across five open-weight configurations (1.7B--9.7B), clean decision accuracy reaches 0.97, yet uncertainty-prompted models miss 32--97% of required escalations. The stronger 9.7B configuration narrows but does not remove the gap, falling from 0.97 clean accuracy to 0.78 under conflict. Verbalized confidence is inconsistent (ECE 0.10--0.54; failure AUROC 0.48--0.77), and a development-tuned confidence-only policy yields no utility gain. A transparent workflow-aware controller improves 5:1 utility for every model and reduces missed escalations to 0.12--0.24, at specificity 0.83--0.93. However, a 30-concept lexical stress test reduces each rule detector's recall from 1.00 on trigger phrases to 0.00 on unseen paraphrases, limiting the controller claim to this benchmark. Seed-clustered statistics, ablations, cross-task transfer, raw outputs, and manifests are packaged for audit. The results motivate explicit workflow-state evaluation while showing that apparently effective routing controls need their own generalization tests.
items.summary_zh: 该基准用 400 个合成医疗工作流情景测试 LLM 在证据缺失、冲突和过期时的澄清、弃答与升级决策。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 结果显示干净输入上的高准确率不能代表升级可靠性；工作流控制器虽改善效用，但词汇压力测试揭示其泛化局限。
items.abstract_zh: 可信的生物医学 AI 不仅需要在静态输入上给出准确答案，还需要在证据缺失、过时、冲突或延迟时可靠地选择行动。我们将一个逐情景评估协议实例化为 400 个合成医疗工作流情景：四类任务各包含 40 个人工编写的语义种子、两种表面参数化和五种受控变体；系统按照 ANSWER/ASK CLARIFICATION/ABSTAIN/ESCALATE 进行评分，并预先声明漏升级与不必要升级的成本比为 5:1。参考行动是单一作者制定的研究政策标签，并非由临床医生裁定的真实标准。在五种开放权重配置（1.7B–9.7B）中，干净决策准确率达到 0.97，但在提示不确定性时，模型漏掉了 32–97% 的必需升级。较强的 9.7B 配置缩小但没有消除这一差距：在冲突条件下，准确率从 0.97 降至 0.78。语言化置信度不一致（ECE 0.10–0.54；失败 AUROC 0.48–0.77），而开发集调优的仅置信度策略没有带来效用增益。透明的工作流感知控制器改善了每个模型的 5:1 效用，并将漏升级率降至 0.12–0.24，特异度为 0.83–0.93。然而，包含 30 个概念的词汇压力测试使每个规则检测器在未见过的释义上的召回率都从触发短语上的 1.00 降至 0.00，因此控制器的结论仅限于该基准。研究将按种子聚类的统计、消融、跨任务迁移、原始输出和清单打包，以便审计。这些结果支持对工作流状态进行显式评估，同时表明，看似有效的路由控制本身也需要进行泛化测试。
